name: Sandbox flow: save, reopen and export a blueprint
description: A provider-free pack over the public sandbox's deterministic store, moderation and blueprint checks. It proves the same edits survive a save and reopen, a tampered save is refused, a hidden note stays hidden after restore, and a restored sandbox still exports a valid blueprint.
limits: The pack runs only the deterministic checks named here. It does not measure model quality, latency or cost.
A pass means these in-repo helpers held on the committed source; it is not a provider, deployment or browser check.
The evidence is a dated run. A later source revision can make the result stale, and the page says so rather than assuming it still holds.
